crossRefs.note: These are the names of the sons of Gershom: Libni and Shimei.
Of the Gershonites: Ladan and Shimei.

people.name: Gershon
people.line: Firstborn son of Levi; head of the Gershonite Levites.

people.name: Jehiel
people.line: Levite leader during the reign of King David

people.name: Libni
people.line: Son of Gershon; grandson of Levi

translations.web: The sons of Ladan, the sons of the Gershonites belonging to Ladan, the heads of the fathers’ households belonging to Ladan the Gershonite: Jehieli.
translations.bsb: From the descendants of Ladan, who were Gershonites through Ladan and heads of the families of Ladan the Gershonite, were Jehieli,
translations.kjv: As concerning the sons of Laadan; the sons of the Gershonite Laadan, chief fathers, even of Laadan the Gershonite, were Jehieli.
translations.asv: The sons of Ladan, the sons of the Gershonites belonging to Ladan, the heads of the fathers' houses belonging to Ladan the Gershonite: Jehieli.
